summary: Iteration 97: B2B ERP Enhancement batch testing complete. All 27 pytest tests passed. Verified: 1) discountType field ('%' or 'Rs') in QuotationItemCreate and InvoiceItemCreate models, 2) Discount calculation logic: Base Rate → Discount → Tax → Total works for both percentage and flat Rs, 3) POST /api/business-tools/quotations/{id}/share-link endpoint exists with 'Powered by UdyogConnect' branding, 4) Public doc router supports 'quotation' document type, 5) PDF services render discount correctly with format (5% with amount, or flat Rs), 6) Frontend has discount toggle buttons with data-testid attributes, 7) Auto-fill price/GST%/HSN from inventory on product select.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 97 tests B2B ERP enhancements: per-item discount system with % or Rs toggle, WhatsApp PDF sharing with time-limited tokens, auto-fill price/GST%/HSN from inventory. All backend endpoints require Firebase auth. The discount calculation flow is: Base = price * qty, DiscAmount = (Base * disc / 100) if type='%' else disc, Taxable = Base - DiscAmount, GST = Taxable * gstPercent / 100, Total = Taxable + GST. PDF services at quotation_pdf_service.py and invoice_pdf_service.py correctly display discount with format.
